name: Johan Van Overtveldt - § 23 - Am 41
title: REPORT on the European Central Bank – annual report 2025
part_text: 23. Welcomes the ongoing discussions on the digital euro; underlines that, in a context of heightened geopolitical uncertainty and excessive dependence on non-EU payment infrastructures, the introduction of a digital euro, designed to complement cash and private banking services, is essential to strengthen EU monetary sovereignty, reduce fragmentation in retail payments and support the integrity and resilience of the single market;
